_source: The single place these values are maintained is SPEC-003 "Hubo-Tack 30-pin backpack schematic and layout design specification" 6.5 (see github.com/hubosmart/hubo-backpack-spec); after a spec revision, sync this file and update spec_version. Only entries already computed with the PCB house calculator, with source and date stated, are accepted; a platform with no entries must not borrow another platform's values.

calculator.note: The first stackup the international calculator recommends is JLC04161H-3313A (two prepregs, dielectric about twice as thick); switch manually to JLC04161H-3313

JLC04161H-3313.params: L1 copper 0.035; 3313 prepreg 0.0994 mm, Dk 4.1; L2 copper 0.0152; core 1.265 mm, Dk 4.6; L3 copper 0.0152; 3313 0.0994; L4 copper 0.035; solder mask Dk 3.8
JLC04161H-3313.stack_note: Used to write the KiCad stackup (scripts/stackup.py); solder mask thickness taken as 0.01 mm from JLCPCB's 0.6 mil over copper; JLCPCB gives no loss tangent, KiCad uses 0.02
JLC04161H-3313.history: The Dk of 3313 used to be 4.05 (old JLCPCB impedance page), now 4.1; 3313 replaces 2313 (same thickness and Dk)
JLC04161H-3313.note: With L4 referenced to L3 the stackup is symmetric, so the same values apply

calculator.note: On first use the designer computes it with the official Huaqiu impedance calculator (or confirms with Huaqiu engineering), fills it into this table and syncs SPEC-003 6.5.3
